task:
FIX THE CI UNIT-TEST REGRESSION ON PR #795 AND FINISH THE DOCKER HUB -> public.ecr.aws MIRROR MOVE FOR THE REMAINING PYTHON DOCKERFILES.

Target branch codex/run-37999308917-1, expected head eefdd06. Fail closed if the head has moved: write nothing and report.

WHY: CI job 'Backend unit tests + compose validate' on eefdd06 fails with exactly one test: tests/test_v3_python_runtime_validation.py::test_python_project_and_container_authorities_are_exactly_314 -> AssertionError: PosixPath('.../apps/api/Dockerfile') assert []. Cause: line 140 uses re.findall(r"^FROM python:([^\s@]+)", text, flags=re.MULTILINE), which no longer matches because the FROM lines in apps/api/Dockerfile and apps/api/Dockerfile.release now start with 'FROM public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:3.14-slim@sha256:...'. 'Backend Code Coverage' and 'Coverage Summary' fail for the same single test. Separately, apps/eddn/Dockerfile and apps/importer/Dockerfile still say 'FROM python:3.14-slim' and apps/maintenance/Dockerfile still says 'FROM python:3.14-alpine'; the 'Built image parity' job runs 'docker compose build api eddn importer', so eddn and importer still pull from Docker Hub and remain exposed to the anonymous pull limit this PR exists to remove.

ALLOWED FILES (any other changed path is a failure): apps/eddn/Dockerfile, apps/importer/Dockerfile, apps/maintenance/Dockerfile, tests/test_v3_python_runtime_validation.py, tests/test_container_image_parity.py, tests/test_backup_restore_ops.py, CHANGES.md.

CHANGE 1 - Dockerfiles. Change ONLY the registry prefix on the FROM line, nothing else:
- apps/eddn/Dockerfile: 'FROM python:3.14-slim' -> 'FROM public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:3.14-slim'
- apps/importer/Dockerfile: 'FROM python:3.14-slim' -> 'FROM public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:3.14-slim'
- apps/maintenance/Dockerfile: 'FROM python:3.14-alpine' -> 'FROM public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:3.14-alpine'
Do not add digest pins (these three were not pinned before; keep tag-following behaviour identical). Do not touch apps/api/Dockerfile, apps/api/Dockerfile.release or apps/web/Dockerfile (already on the mirror with unchanged digests).

CHANGE 2 - tests/test_v3_python_runtime_validation.py, test_python_project_and_container_authorities_are_exactly_314. Replace the regex at line 140 with one that REQUIRES the mirror prefix: r"^FROM public\.ecr\.aws/docker/library/python:([^\s@]+)" (multiline). Keep 'assert python_bases, path', keep the 3.14- prefix check and the OLD_PYTHON check. Add one extra assertion in the same loop: assert not re.search(r"^FROM python:", text, flags=re.MULTILINE), path  -- so a bare Docker Hub python base can never come back in any of the five Dockerfiles. Also check OLD_PYTHON (lines 20-26): its alternative r"FROM\s+python:3\.(?:11|12|13)\b" only matches a bare 'FROM python:'; extend it so an old version behind the mirror prefix is also caught, e.g. r"FROM\s+(?:public\.ecr\.aws/docker/library/)?python:3\.(?:11|12|13)\b". Nothing else in that file.

CHANGE 3 - tests/test_container_image_parity.py. (a) Line 201: 'FROM python:3.14-alpine' -> 'FROM public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:3.14-alpine'. (b) In test_ci_and_review_lab_do_not_use_bare_docker_hub_library_images, extend the dockerfiles list to also include ROOT / 'apps/eddn/Dockerfile', ROOT / 'apps/importer/Dockerfile', ROOT / 'apps/maintenance/Dockerfile' so the existing 'FROM must start with the mirror prefix' scan covers all six Dockerfiles. Nothing else.

CHANGE 4 - tests/test_backup_restore_ops.py line 315: 'FROM python:3.14-alpine' -> 'FROM public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:3.14-alpine'. Nothing else.

CHANGE 5 - CHANGES.md: extend this PR's existing entry (do not add a second entry) with one sentence saying the eddn, importer and maintenance Python base images now also come from public.ecr.aws/docker/library with unchanged tags, and that the runtime-authority test now requires the mirror prefix.
